QUESTIONS / ANSWERED
Good questions deserve direct answers.
What kind of websites do you build?
I work on responsive business sites, WordPress websites, landing pages and useful web tools. The scope follows what visitors need to do.
Can we work together outside Jabalpur?
Yes. Discovery, design reviews and delivery can be handled remotely. Any in-person requirements are agreed before work begins.
Should I choose WordPress or a custom website?
Choose based on editing needs and functionality. WordPress is useful for frequent content updates; a custom build can suit a focused workflow.
How long will a website take?
It depends on the page count, content readiness, integrations and review rounds. I would define a realistic timeline after understanding the brief.
What should I send to get started?
A short description of your business, audience, goals, existing website if any, and examples of what you like are enough for a first conversation.
